source_groups: G282 Element X F-Droid GET timeout
problem: A pinned APK can consume a long transfer attempt before an equivalent publisher artifact is identified; same-version alternatives can also have different bytes.
repeated_cost: G282 F-Droid Element X attempt spent 250.015 seconds and stopped without an admissible APK. G282 shortlist separately exposed same-version channel ambiguity.
decision_to_improve: Route an exact upstream SHA/size to a publisher asset using published digest metadata before any large GET.
baseline: Fetch the historical F-Droid URL first, then inspect APK bytes; observed G282 timeout with no raw count change.

options.name: repeat historical URL
options.changed_assumption: same endpoint will complete next time
options.cheapest_falsifier: HEAD/transfer probe does not prove full completion
options.stop: do not retry old partial blindly

options.name: publisher digest route
options.changed_assumption: publisher API may expose the exact artifact SHA
options.risk: metadata may drift or be absent
options.cheapest_falsifier: small release API response digest and exact asset ID/name/size check

selected_one_improvement: Pre-GET content-identity routing gate keyed by upstream package, version code, artifact SHA-256 and bytes plus publisher repo/tag/asset ID/name; use a fresh official API response, require digest and size equality, otherwise keep alternatives separate. Revalidate at actual GET and hash complete payload before admission.
version_architecture: AOSP16 R4 / OH7 arm64 portfolio; Element X 26.09.1 code 202609012 and Element Classic 1.6.62 code 40106622 pilot controls.
cost_cap: metadata requests only; no APK GET, SSH, device, container or graph
acceptance: Positive Element X exact digest equality and negative Element Classic flavor mismatch in under 20 seconds of network time, with raw API responses and command receipts retained.
rollback: If publisher API lacks digest, changes identity, or payload hash later differs, reject the route and retain the historical registered artifact as separate.
